name: Response Drill
roles: Junior Incident Response Analyst · SOC Analyst I
headline: Recover access with evidence.
description: Practice a containment-and-recovery sequence with explicit prerequisites and an inspectable exercise clock.
guide: Capture evidence, revoke sessions, and disable the account. Inspect the containment checkpoint.
Append rotate-credentials, validate-recovery, and restore-account to complete recovery.
Try restoring before validation. The state machine must reject the sequence and explain the missing prerequisite.
limits: This is a tabletop state-machine exercise. It changes no live account and executes no OS commands. Durations are simulated, not measured operational performance.
